verdict: Meta ROAS accelerating; Google Business Profile drop is being investigated now.
narrative: This period, your Meta ads delivered a 5.58x return on $1,480 in spend, with purchases up 25% and ROAS up 18.9% compared to the prior seven days — efficiency is clearly moving in the right direction. Your Google Business Profile drove 620 actions over the 28 days, including 43 calls and 104 direction requests, but activity fell sharply in the final four days of the period, pulling the weekly comparison down 62%. We're investigating that drop now to confirm whether it reflects a data or visibility issue and will have clarity before next week's report. Four project milestones from August are also being cleared this week to keep the broader build on schedule. Next period you should expect the GBP picture to be resolved and the remaining September deliverables — including automation flows and subscribe pages — to go live on or before September 30.
